items.title: Hourly review highlights disagreement over exchange outflow estimates
items.summary: The Trading Journey report cites Reuters coverage of approximately $3.64 billion in Binance withdrawals after services resumed. It also notes DefiLlama's higher $5.81 billion estimate, which Binance disputes on the basis of internal wallet movements. The review describes the exchange-security backdrop as mixed rather than clearly bullish.
items.source_time: Source publication reported by ChatGPT: November 2, 2026, 01:53 UTC
items.caveat: Imported AI research, not independently verified by TradeZilla. Competing estimates should not be combined or treated as confirmed Bitcoin spot sales.

items.summary: The Trading Journey review cites a new Reuters report describing approximately $3.64 billion in Binance customer withdrawals after services resumed, alongside the exchange's statement that flows were stabilizing and most stolen assets had been covered. The review also attributes a roughly $1.2 billion decline in combined USDT and USDC market capitalization since Friday to that coverage. It characterizes these developments as mixed risk signals, not a confirmed bullish catalyst.
